fields.name: event_session_facts.Session_id
fields.comment: A unique identifier for the user's browsing session.

fields.name: event_session_facts.Session_start
fields.comment: The timestamp of the very first event recorded in the session.

fields.name: event_session_facts.Session_end
fields.comment: The timestamp of the final event recorded in the session.

fields.name: event_session_facts.Session_landing_page
fields.comment: The type of event that initiated the session, representing the user's entry point.

fields.name: event_session_facts.Session_exit_page
fields.comment: The type of event that concluded the session, representing the user's last action.

fields.name: event_session_facts.Count
fields.comment: The total count of unique sessions.

fields.name: event_session_funnel.Session_id
fields.comment: A unique identifier for the user's browsing session. The unique identifier for the user session being tracked through the funnel.

fields.name: event_session_funnel.Event1_time
fields.comment: The timestamp of the first 'Product' view event in the session.

fields.name: event_session_funnel.Event2_time
fields.comment: The timestamp of the first 'Cart' addition event in the session.

fields.name: event_session_funnel.Event3_time
fields.comment: The timestamp of the first 'Purchase' event in the session.

fields.name: event_session_funnel.Event1_before_event2
fields.comment: Boolean flag indicating if the product was viewed before an item was added to the cart.

fields.name: event_session_funnel.Event2_before_event3
fields.comment: Boolean flag indicating if the cart addition happened before the final purchase.

fields.name: event_session_funnel.Time_in_funnel
fields.comment: The total duration in hours from the first product view to the final conversion or cart action.

fields.name: event_session_funnel.Count
fields.comment: The total number of funnel records.

fields.name: event_session_funnel.Count_Sessions
fields.comment: The total number of unique sessions entering the funnel.

fields.name: event_session_funnel.Count_Sessions_event1
fields.comment: The number of sessions that reached the first step (Product View).

fields.name: event_session_funnel.Count_Sessions_event12
fields.comment: The number of sessions that successfully moved from Product View to Cart in the correct chronological order.

fields.name: event_session_funnel.Count_Sessions_event123
fields.comment: The number of sessions that completed the full journey from Product to Cart to Purchase in order.
